body:
Having this problem since upgrading from 1.48 to 1.49.1

Normally "progress" updates every half second and the elapsed time counts half seconds. But at some point the elapsed counter starts counting every half second as full seconds. It initially counted half seconds. So mid run this problem starts

This causes issues with various parts of the progress

See the screenshot below. My speed is limited to 3MB/s. You can see that from the 4 active transfers.
This has actually been running for 1 hour and 10 minutes
The elapsed time is wrong which is probably the cause of the average tranfer speed
The average transfer speed is wrong which causes the ETA to be wrong

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/912973/64478655-873c4e80-d1ab-11e9-99ca-3e11c31ea34c.png)

On a side-note. I feel elapsed time should include checking time and everything else. If you only want to count "transfer time" then that is something else then elapsed time (or run time)

Just found the moment it starts counting half seconds as full seconds.
It starts after the first queued transfer starts (so after at least 1 transfer has finished)

> Just found the moment it starts counting half seconds as full seconds.
> It starts after the first queued transfer starts (so after at least 1 transfer has finished)

I think what is happening is that when the first queued transfer starts the counter is reset.  Do you think that is correct?

If with reset you mean it starts from zero, no it does not.

At the end Rclone does correct itself before writing the final progress into the log file
